themes.title: Agent workflows and interfaces
themes.content: Several fast-rising projects package specialized capabilities for agents: security testing and reporting skills, a software-development methodology, multi-source research, and CLI harnesses for existing software.

themes.title: Agent information access
themes.content: Web crawling and search infrastructure is represented by Firecrawl, while last30days-skill assembles research across multiple platforms into a single brief.

themes.title: Creative, media, and utility tools
themes.content: Agent-assisted diagram generation and local AI video clipping sit alongside a general-purpose downloader, showing strong attention to concrete user-facing tools beyond model infrastructure.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Daily snapshot at 2026-11-27 03:26 UTC; date range 2026-11-27 through 2026-11-27. Ranking uses the supplied deterministic score, with matching daily Trending gains as the primary attention signal.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-centric tooling dominates this snapshot: security workflows, web research access, and repeatable coding-agent methods occupy the strongest momentum signals. Claude-BugHunter leads (+1,597 stars; score 10.877), followed by Firecrawl and an agent diagram-design skill.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
sections.why_notable: Highest supplied score (10.877), highest daily gain (+1,597), and 7 trending days in the last 30. README describes 85 skills and 681 disclosed-report patterns.
sections.unique_caveat: The README frames use around authorized red-team and bug-hunting engagements; keep testing within explicit scope.
sections.content: Claude-BugHunter is a Claude Code skill bundle for security testing workflows, with vulnerability-class playbooks, attack-chain guidance, triage, and reporting. Its supplied signal score is 10.877 with +1,597 daily stars and 7 trending days in the last 30.

sections.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
sections.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
sections.why_notable: Score 10.454, +1,046 daily stars, and 7 trending days in the last 30. README documents local scraping, hosted search, and a self-hosted server.
sections.content: Firecrawl offers local scraping/crawling, a hosted service with search and data-provider access, and a self-hostable server to supply agent-ready web content. Its supplied score is 10.454 with +1,046 daily stars.

sections.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
sections.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
sections.why_notable: Score 10.363, +955 daily stars, and 7 trending days in the last 30. README describes 52 diagram types and self-contained HTML/SVG output.
sections.content: An agent skill creates branded, standalone HTML/SVG diagrams from natural-language requests. The project advertises 52 diagram types and supports multiple coding-agent hosts. Signal: score 10.363 and +955 daily stars.

sections.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
sections.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。
sections.why_notable: Score 10.291, +889 daily stars, and 7 trending days in the last 30. README lists web/video, streaming, FTP, and peer-to-peer protocols plus a browser extension workflow.
sections.unique_caveat: README warns that Qt 6.6+ no longer supports CPUs without AVX.
sections.content: A multi-platform download manager that combines common web, video, streaming, and peer-to-peer workflows, and offers a browser-extension-to-desktop handoff. Signal: score 10.291 and +889 daily stars.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
sections.why_notable: Score 10.251, +854 daily stars, and 7 trending days in the last 30. Its documented loop specifies, plans, then implements with TDD and subagents.
sections.content: A composable agentic development method that guides coding agents from specification through planning to subagent-driven implementation, emphasizing red/green TDD. Signal: score 10.251 and +854 daily stars.

sections.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
sections.description: AutoClip｜The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. 一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。

sections.content: A local-first desktop video tool that finds highlights in files, links, and live-stream replays, then adds speaker tracking, captions, covers, and social-ready exports; it also exposes MCP support. Signal: score 10.153 and +774 daily stars.

sections.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
sections.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
sections.why_notable: Score 10.133, +759 daily stars, and 7 trending days in the last 30. README calls the v4 pipeline engagement-scored and agent-led; it notes some sources require setup or credentials.

sections.content: An AI-agent research skill that searches platform content, uses engagement signals to rank what it finds, and synthesizes a brief. Its README says some source connectors require configuration. Signal: score 10.133 and +759 daily stars.

sections.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
sections.why_notable: Score 10.116, +746 daily stars, and 7 trending days in the last 30. README describes reusable CLI harnesses and a community registry for agent interfaces to software.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent workflow infrastructure is prominent across Claude-BugHunter, Superpowers, last30days-skill, and CLI-Anything. Firecrawl and last30days-skill illustrate agent-oriented information access. Diagram-design, AutoClip, and Ghost-Downloader-3 show additional momentum in purpose-built creative, media, and utility applications. The selected languages are Python (5/8), TypeScript (1/8), HTML (1/8), and Shell (1/8).

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest signal is demand for practical agent extensions: tools that connect agents to information, encode repeatable workflows, or produce concrete outputs. Specialized user-facing software also features strongly, so the snapshot extends beyond model infrastructure. Star attention alone is not a quality or adoption audit.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: GitHub Trending daily, https://github.com/trending?since=daily, with deterministic candidates from the dated signal JSON. Corroboration: successful repository pages, exact GitHub Search API repository matches, and captured current default-branch commits for all selected entries. The live daily page confirmed each selected stars_gained value. Total stars are the signal capture values. Star snapshots were unavailable because GitHub CLI authentication was missing; all one-, seven-, and thirty-day snapshot deltas are null, not zero. No prior-window comparison supports a Notable Shifts section.
